title: Correo
description: a single sealed envelope, folded thick ivory ceramic with a soft crease, closed by a violet wax-seal disc with a fine champagne-gold rim.

title: Conversaciones
description: two overlapping rounded speech bubbles, the larger in ivory ceramic and the smaller in violet enamel, joined by a fine champagne-gold seam.

title: Clientes
description: three ivory ceramic spheres of different sizes connected by slender champagne-gold arcs, like a small constellation of relationships.

title: Facturación
description: a crisp ivory ceramic invoice sheet with softly embossed horizontal ruled lines and a raised violet circular seal edged in champagne gold, tilted slightly in space.

title: Archivos
description: three stacked ivory ceramic file folders with softly rounded corners, the front folder opening in violet enamel and a thin champagne-gold tab.

title: Agenda
description: a single calendar tile in ivory ceramic with rounded corners, one raised violet date block and a champagne-gold ring binding at the top.

title: Plan de trabajo
description: three stacked ivory ceramic task cards fanned in depth, the front card carrying a single raised champagne-gold check mark.

title: Asistente
description: a faceted four-pointed star sculpted in violet enamel with a small champagne-gold sphere at its center, floating above a subtle ivory ceramic base.

title: Registros
description: a precise three-by-three grid of nine small ivory ceramic tiles set in a violet enamel frame, with one tile slightly raised in champagne gold like a selected record.

title: Objetivos
description: a concentric target of three ivory ceramic rings with violet inner rings and a small champagne-gold sphere at the exact center.

title: Tesorería
description: a short stack of thick ivory ceramic coins with champagne-gold rims and one coin standing upright on edge in violet enamel.

title: Compras
description: a sculptural ivory ceramic shopping bag with softly inflated body, a violet enamel handle and a small champagne-gold tag.

title: Rentabilidad
description: three ascending beveled ivory ceramic bars of increasing height with champagne-gold top edges, the middle bar inlaid with a thin violet enamel stripe.

title: Atención
description: a sculptural customer-support headset in ivory ceramic with two violet enamel ear cushions connected by a slim champagne-gold arch, one earpiece turned toward the viewer with a fine boom microphone.

title: Firmas
description: an elegant fountain-pen nib sculpted in champagne gold standing upright, set into a violet enamel grip section, its slit and breather hole crisply defined.

title: Automatizaciones
description: two interlocking mechanical gears, one in ivory ceramic and one in violet enamel, with champagne-gold tooth edges and a visible machined axle hole.

title: Procedimientos
description: three stepped ivory ceramic slabs ascending like a staircase, each with a shallow engraved rounded square, the top step inlaid with a small champagne-gold check mark.

title: Equipo
description: three abstract figures sculpted as smooth ivory ceramic forms with rounded heads and softly tapered shoulders, standing shoulder to shoulder, the central figure in violet enamel, a fine champagne-gold line unifying their bases.

title: Personas
description: a single abstract portrait bust sculpted in smooth ivory ceramic with a softly rounded head and shoulders, a slender champagne-gold arc tracing the back of the head like a delicate hairline, on a violet enamel base.

title: Gastos
description: a rolled ivory ceramic receipt scroll with softly curling edges, wrapped by a violet enamel band with a tiny champagne-gold clasp.

title: Cobros
description: a thick ivory ceramic payment card standing slightly tilted with a champagne-gold chip and one embossed stripe, accompanied by a small violet enamel sphere resting beside it.

title: Diseño
description: an artist's oval palette sculpted in ivory ceramic with a violet enamel thumb hole and a small mound of violet paint, alongside a slim champagne-gold brush resting across it.

title: Publicaciones
description: three slim ivory ceramic cards floating in a fanned stack, the front card inlaid with a violet enamel broadcast arc and a small champagne-gold dot at its origin.

title: Tienda
description: a miniature sculptural shopfront with a softly arched ivory ceramic facade and a scalloped awning of alternating violet and ivory panels, a champagne-gold door handle at the center.

title: Soporte
description: a sculptural lifebuoy ring in ivory ceramic with four violet enamel segments and a fine champagne-gold rope looped around it.

title: Inventario
description: two stacked ivory ceramic storage crates with softly rounded edges and slatted sides, the upper crate bearing a small violet enamel label plate with a champagne-gold corner.

title: Mantenimiento
description: an elegant open-end wrench sculpted in champagne-gold metal with a violet enamel handle insert, angled diagonally with a crisp jaw opening.

title: Producción
description: a compact sculptural production line: an ivory ceramic base with three small violet enamel blocks moving along it and a slim champagne-gold robotic arm arched above the middle block.

title: Cumplimiento
description: a heraldic shield sculpted in ivory ceramic with a softly beveled border, a violet enamel field and a raised champagne-gold check mark at its center.

title: Accesos
description: a large sculptural key with a rounded violet enamel bow, an ivory ceramic shaft and two crisp champagne-gold teeth.

title: Portal cliente
description: an elegant arched portal sculpted in ivory ceramic with a deep violet enamel interior, standing on a slim champagne-gold threshold, like a private client doorway.

title: Conocimiento
description: an open book sculpted in ivory ceramic with softly curved pages, a violet enamel spine and delicate champagne-gold page edges, seen from a three-quarter angle.

title: Observabilidad IA
description: a circular instrument dial in ivory ceramic with a violet enamel outer ring and a slender champagne-gold needle pointing upward, like a precision observability gauge.

title: Tableros
description: three vertical ivory ceramic board columns of different heights, each holding two or three small violet enamel tiles, the tallest column topped with a champagne-gold cap.

title: Centro de Mando
description: a circular command console sculpted in ivory ceramic with a violet enamel inset ring and a champagne-gold compass needle, four subtle gold cardinal marks around the bezel.
